text: The climax of the middle section. The trombones and tuba enter: bars 60–64 are the only bars they play in the whole movement.
short: Trombones and tuba: their only bars

text: D♭ major, G♭ major, then F♭ major. F♭ major sounds the same as E major, the dominant of A minor, so it opens the way to A minor.
short: F♭ major = E major, the dominant of A minor

text: Trombone 1 plays its only notes of the movement: the first theme of Movement I (bar 15), in the same rhythm, moved from C minor to A minor.
short: Movement I's first theme, now in A minor

text: Under its last notes: the diminished seventh that stops the music in Movement I (bar 26), then E7 and a French sixth, which slides down a semitone to E♭7, the dominant that leads back to A♭ major.
short: Movement I's stop chord, then a French sixth
